subject: Post-call recap: audit-log retention, DPA redlines, pen-test & evidence path
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@ledgeredge.com>, Devin Park <devin@ledgeredge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: audit-log retention, DPA redlines, pen-test & evidence path

Hi Alice / Devin —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap while items are fresh and to make sure we’re aligned on next steps. I’ve bolded asks and deadlines where feasible.

1) Key pain / goals from today's call
- Audit + forensic log retention: LedgerEdge needs 24 months of immutable audit log retention for user activity and admin actions.
- SOC 2 scope: LedgerEdge is focused on scope for production data plane only; you asked about Redwood’s current SOC 2 coverage and how evidence maps to our hosted offering.
- DPA redlines: you’ll send a first-pass redline; legal wants clear language on subprocessing and log retention responsibilities.
- Pen test evidence & schedule: you’d like to confirm past pen-test reports and discuss a vendor-led pen test cadence (annual + major-release).

2) What Redwood can provide (summary)
- Audit logs: default 90 days retained; we can provision 24-month retention for enterprise tenants with archived write-once storage backed by customer-approved KMS.
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (security + availability) — we maintain an evidence index and can extract artifacts scoped to the production data plane.
- Pen tests: summary reports available (redacted) + we support customer-conducted tests with a scoping questionnaire and test window.
- DPA: we can accept reasonable retention-related redlines; will need to review specific language around immutable archives and termination retention.

3) Concrete asks (owners and tentative dates)
- Alice: please share the DPA redline by Fri 2026-09-17 so legal can triage (External)
- Devin: confirm whether LedgerEdge requires an in-country copy of archived logs or if encrypted remote storage is sufficient by Mon 2026-09-20 (External)
- Aditya: prepare SOC 2 evidence index export and a short summary of what artifacts map to "production data plane" by Thu 2026-09-16 (Internal / Owner)
- Grace: outline proposed retention config and cost delta for 24-month audit log retention + backup retention policy details by Thu 2026-09-16 (Internal / Owner)

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx (artifact index), standard-DPA-template.pdf (for context).

Next sync suggestion: 30 min follow-up the week of Sep 21 after we have the DPA redline and the retention confirmation.

If I missed anything, flag it and I’ll update the action list.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Principal Solutions 
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[attachment: redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: Alice Monroe <alice@ledgeredge.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Devin Park <devin@ledgeredge.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: audit-log retention, DPA redlines, pen-test & evidence path

Hi Laura / team —

Thanks for the crisp summary, really helpful. A couple clarifying q's from our side before we redline:

- Retention: if Redwood can support a 24-month WORM-style archive backed by our KMS, that covers the requirement. Can you confirm whether exported logs will be in a searchable format (e.g., JSON/CSV) or an object-store archive snapshot?

- Backups vs audit logs: LedgerEdge treats backups as separate from audit logs; backups need 365-day retention and are included in e-discovery scope. Can you confirm options to separate backup retention and audit log retention?

- SOC 2 evidence: is the "production data plane" carve-out something you can produce as a discrete evidence bundle? If so, please include an index we can hand to our risk team.

I’ll aim to share the DPA redline by Friday, but we may ask for a short call with your legal team if there are tight windows.

Appreciate it —
Alice
Alice Monroe
Head of Security, LedgerEdge
alice@ledgeredge.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@ledgeredge.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: audit-log retention, DPA redlines, pen-test & evidence path

Hi Alice / team —

Quick responses to the questions so you have the details before you draft:

- Format: audit logs can be exported as newline-delimited JSON or CSV streams for search/indexing; our archived WORM store will retain objects (one per day) and we provide a retrieval API that returns NDJSON.

- Backup vs audit logs: we treat backups and audit logs as distinct retention classes. Out-of-the-box retention: audit logs 90 days, backups 365 days. We can enable a 24-month audit-log archive tier and keep backups at 365 days. See attached short config notes.

- SOC 2 evidence: Laura attached the evidence index in the original email (redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx). I’ll export a scoped bundle for "production data plane" and drop it in the shared drive link by end of day Thu 2026-09-16.

Action owners noted: Grace will produce the cost delta for the extended audit-log tier and the exact configuration steps.

- Security specifics: encryption-at-rest is AES-256; we can configure customer-managed keys (KMS) for the archive tier and provide key-rotation logs.

If you prefer a short 15-min tech sync to walk the retrieval API and archive format, I’m available Thu morning.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
[attachment: audit-archive-config-notes.txt (txt)]
From: Devin Park <devin@ledgeredge.com>

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: audit-log retention, DPA redlines, pen-test & evidence path

Laura / team —

All clear from my side. Two quick commitments:

1) We will send the DPA redline by EOD Fri 2026-09-17. Expect a few narrow asks around subprocessors and retention termination windows — nothing major.

2) LedgerEdge will plan a vendor-led pen test for the week of Oct 12. I’ll share the testing scope and approved vendor list next week.

Agree on the 30-min follow-up week of Sep 21 — please send 3 time options and we’ll pick one. Also, please attach the SOC 2 evidence bundle when ready; our risk team prefers a Drive link.

Thanks —
Devin Park
VP Engineering, LedgerEdge
devin@ledgeredge.com
